tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bstan srung bse khrab can la ru mtshon 'dzugs chog khams gsum dpal 'bar zhes bya ba bzhugs so// bla ma dang padma he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir bstan srung bse khrab can la bsten pa'i ru mtshon 'dzugs chog ni/ gsom dang glang ma ma yin pa'i shing zlum po ring thung ji ltar rigs pa mtshal lam btsag dang dug khrag la sogs pas dmar por bsgyur/ mi rta khyi gsum bsad pa'i lcags la rtse gsum mam ral gri so gnyis ma rtsa ba sbubs stong rtse mo me ris can bskyon la 'brong g.yag gang rung 'bras bu can gyi rnga ma dkar dmar gang rigs ༈ rnga ma dkar dmar gyis bgyis tshe nag po kho na ma 'byor ba rnams la phan pa dang / dmar po ni 'di rang gi sku mdog dang bstun la/ don thob la ni nag po yin te ru mtshon 'di dag phal cher bdud kyi cha lugs yin pas so// shing rgya gram sogs la bsten nas bskyon pa'i nang du sku rten ro ras la gri khrag gis sku 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin bris/ gsung rten bsdus pa ni/ oṃ āḥhrīḥm hā rā dza hūm̐/ bstan srung bse khrab can 'khor bcas ru mtshon gyi rgyal mtshan 'di la brtan par bzhugs nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs sogs rang gang 'dod kyi spel tshig sbyar te mdung shing gi rtse mo la dkris pa'i phyi nas tshon skud kyis bcings la la chas byugs/ thugs rten ni me long gi ngos la gri khrag dang sindhu ras hrīḥbris/ yon tan gyi rten du dar ras kyi khug mar rdzas nyer lnga sogs dngos po gya nom gzhug phrin las kyi rten du drag shing byang bu mtho gang la gong gi sngags spel tshig can yig phreng du bris pa dang / lcags dang bse'i byang bu mig dgu pa stag gzig dang dar ras sna tshogs kyi ras ma/ 'gron bu dril bu/ g.yer kha/ mi'i mgo lag snying sogs btags la/ de lta bu'i thug de tshugs dang mgon khang gi steng ngam/ gang rigs su brten par btsugs pa'i mdun du stegs bu gzhi bzang gi khar 'bru sna tshogs bcal du bkram/

snod bzang por khrag chang bdud rtsi ril bu zan dang sbyar ba'i gtor ma gru gsum che ba gcig gi phyogs mtshams brgyad dang / mdun gyi g.yon rnams su gru gsum chung ba re bkod pa'i mthar mtheb skyu brgya rtsa sogs kyis bskor ba la sha mar gyi rgyan dang mda' dar dmar po btsugs/ de'i drung du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer mchod/ de'i mdun du g.yas su sha mar dum bu dgu dang chang phud gtsang ma/ g.yon du phye mar dang khrag mdun du gsol kha'i snod gtor theb gsum/ sbyang chas/ rang gi mdun du rdor dril sogs nyer mkho rnams ma tshang ba med par bshams la/ rta mgrin sogs yi dam gang rung gi bdag bskyed bum sgrub sngon du btang nas thug la sbyangs khrus bya/ mchod gtor bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi kā pa la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag gi rgya mtsho/ rus pa'i ri bo/ zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ phyag rgya dang bcas ci mang brjod/ ru mtshon bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yi ge hrīḥdamar po de las 'od zer 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ mgon po bse'i khrab can sku mdog padma rā ga'i phung po ltar dmar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa spyan gsum sdang mig phyogs bcur gzigs pa/ zhal bsgrad cing mche ba gtsigs pas gnod byed ru tra'i srog dbugs skad cig la len pa/ phyag g.yas tsandan gyi bing chen klad la bskor zhing / sprul pa 'bum sde'i dmag tshogs 'dren pa/ g.yon zhags pa khra bo thugs kar bsnams nas bstan pa spyi dgra'i tshe srog gcod pa/ dbu la bse yi rmog zhu dar dmar cod paṇa gyis mdzes pa gsol zhing / bse khrab khra bo sku la mnabs pa/ dar ljang khu'i stod g.yogs dang dar dmar gyi 'jol ber khrab 'og tu gsol ba/

gdug pa can gyi snying rtsa gcod par byed pa'i ral gri dang / chos 'khor rgyal chen skyong ba'i stag dong thog ser gyis gang ba g.yas su 'khyil zhing / bdud bzhi 'joms par byed pa'i gzhu chu srin gyi mgo'i mchog ma can gzig shubs dang bcas pa g.yon du bsnams pa/ rlung gi shugs 'gros kyis stong gsum yud kyis bskor ba'i rta mchog rag pa la chibs shing / mtsha' lu rting dkar rol du khrid pa/ me ri 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas su sku yi sprul pa ne'u gru bzhi'i klu btsan sku mdog mthing nag sku la ber nag dgu brtsegs gsol ba/ mthing nag dar gyi thod bcings byas pa/ lag na sbrul nag gi zhags pa thogs pa/ rta mchog bra nag bzhon par byas pa/ sprul pa sbrul nag 'bum sde 'gyed pa/ g.yon du gsung gi sprul pa bse khrab can sku mdog dmar nag ras dmar ber chen sku la gsol ba/ g.yas btsan zhags dmar po bsnams pa/ g.yon 'phan dar dmar po bsnams pa/ chibs su btsan rta dmar po chibs pa/ sprul pa spre'u dmar 'bum sde 'gyed pa/ mdun na thugs kyi sprul pa steng phyogs lha'i srung ma sku mdog dkar po/ rin chen dar dkar sku la gsol zhing / phyag g.yas zhags pa dkar po 'dzin pa/ g.yon rta mchog kha lo sgyur ba/ lha rta dkar po'i steng na 'gying ba/ dge slong bzang por sprul pa 'gyed pa/ rje'i rgyal po rin po che shin tu mtshar ba'i skyes bu chen po/ za 'og dmar khra sku la gsol ba/ phyag g.yas sba lcags dkar po bsnams pa/ g.yon dung dkar 'brug stong ldir ba/ cang shes bra nag chibs su chibs pa/ dpa' bo stag chas sprul pa 'gyed pa/ rgyab tu yon tan gyi sprul pa chos gter srung ma sku mdog dkar po/ dar dkar ras dkar sku la gsol ba/ le brgan dar gyi 'dzum thod bcings pa/ g.yas zhags pa dkar po bsnams pa/ g.yon sba lcags dkar po bsnams pa/ mtsha' lu rting dkar la bzhon pa byas pa/

byi la gwa pa sprul par 'gyed pa/ mtshams bzhir phrin las kyi sprul pa mgon po dmag bcas sku mdog dmar ser/ bse khrab phra bo sku la gsol ba/ dar gyi 'dzum thod sprin ltar gtibs pa/ g.yas zhags pa dkar po klad la bskor zhing / g.yon sba lcags dkar po bsnams pa/ rag pa rting dkar chibs su chibs pa/ sngags pa nag po pho nyar 'gyed pa/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'o/ /rang gi snying ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ chos 'khor yer pa dang / dpal ldan gsang phu'i gnas nas chos skyong ba'i rgyal po bse khrab can 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ rdor dril 'dzin pas/ hūm̐ bkra shis lha yi gzhal yas khang chen nas/ /tshur byon tshur byon rgyal chen bse khrab can/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag las kun sgrub slad dang / /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol/ /sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi/ /rje yi sprul pa yang sprul sa ya dang / /las mkhan pho nya 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /rnal 'byor phrin las bsgrub phyir gshegs su gsol/ /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ hrīḥm hā rā dza ti i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum gyis phul/ 'khor rnams la/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma ṇaṃ a dya nutpanna twata oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum gyis phul/ a sogs kyis mchod/ chos skyong ba'i srung ma bse khrab can 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams/ mchod sbyin gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung / dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs/ khyad par du yang rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi 'gal rkyen phyi nang gsang gsum gyi bar chad thams cad srungs/ mthun rkyen tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa 'khor dang longs spyod snyan grags legs pa'i yon tan thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang /

khyad par bdag gi bsam pa'i don 'di nyid gegs med du 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ rang nyid yi dam du gsal ba dang mdun bskyed rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dang / khyad par bstan srung bse khrab can dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya bya/ dar 'phyar dung rnga rol sogs 'bud dkrol/ spos dkar dang tshil chen gyi dud pa sbyar/ g.yab dar g.yab cing gdung dbyangs dang bcas pas spyan 'dren pa ni/ bdag chen rgya gar bas mdzad pa'i bsangs yig spyan 'dren gyi dbu nas shlau ka gnyis dang / gsang phu ba don grub legs bzang gis mdzad pa'i bse khrab bskang gso nas 'byung ba'i spyan 'dren ni/ hūm̐ rab dmar srin po khros 'dra'i sa 'dzin khang / /sog po'i sna ltar mkha' la snyegs pa'i gnas/ /rab bzhugs khro bo'i rgyal po bse khrab can/ /ma thogs myur du bsgral ba'i las la byon/ /bde ba'i dpal ster bkra shis lha yi khang / /sum cu rtsa gsum chos kyi pho brang nas/ /sngags srung nag po mthu stobs nag po che/ /las bzhi bsgrub phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /rgya gar u rgyan bod yul gtsug lag khang / /ma lus bsrung mar khas blangs dpa' bo che/ /mna' zan tshe srog 'bral ba'i las la brtson/ /bdud 'dul dpa' bo gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi sku gcig po/ /snyigs ma'i dus su rgyal po'i chas su ston/ /rgyud sde'i snying po 'gro don gter du sbas/ /padma'i bka' bstod gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i spyan 'dren ni/ hūm̐ phan bde kun 'byung bstan pa dar ba'i gnas/ /gsang phu la sogs bod kyi chos grwa che/ /dge 'dun 'du ba'i gnas rnams skyong mdzad pa'i/ /mthu ldan bka' srung gnyan po bse khrab can/

/'khor dang bcas pa bla ma gong ma yi/ /bka' dang dam tshig gnyan po dran byas nas/ /rnal 'byor bdag gis da lta spyan 'dren na/ /'khor dang bcas pa skad cig gnas 'dir byon/ /hūm̐ sbyar ba'i spos dang g.yab pa'i dar/ /rnga chen sgra dang dung chen gling / /rnal 'byor drag po'i ngar skad kyis/ /spyan 'dren ma thogs myur du byon/ /dam can rgya mtsho mthu rtsal can/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa skyong ba rnams/ /gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod/ /dam tshig dbang gis 'dus gyur cig /oṃ hrīḥm hā rā dza sa pa ri wā ra e hya hi badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ mtshan sngags kyi mjug tu grihṇa daṃ a nas shapta'i bar dang / mtshan sngags kyi mjug tu 'bru gsum btags pas mchod/ bsnyen pa dang las su rung ba'i rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis ru mtshon la rdo rje gzungs thag btags pa nas bzung / rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros chos skyong 'khor bcas la phog pas thugs rgyud bskul nas rang 'dra'i sprul pas dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad/ 'khor 'das kyi nus mthu rnams tshur 'dus/ ru mtshon lhar bskyed pa la thim pas gzi brjid dang ldan par bsam la/ bdag bskyed gang byas kyi sngags kha shas dang / oṃ āḥhrīḥm hā rā dza hūm̐ zhes brgya rtsa sogs 'ur 'don byas pa'i mthar/ sgrub po mang du yod na kha shas kyis gzungs thag nas bzung la 'og gi bskul ma ran bar sngags bzla/ slob dpon sogs gzhan rnams kyis gsol kha bya ba ni/ las kyi rdo rjes gong gi snod gsum du g.yas nas sha dang / g.yon nas phye mar mtheb skyu re bcug gsol kha re la de 'dra lan gsum re gtor ma la bstabs cing / g.yas g.yon gyi khrag chang nas kyang cung zad re blug gzhan rnams kyis rnga rol dbyangs dang bcas shing / dgra bgegs sha khrag thams cad mdun bskyed kyi zhal du bstabs par bsams la/ hūm̐ mgon po'i mtshan gsol dpal ldan bse khrab che/

/sku gsung thugs yon phrin las sprul par bcas/ /bstan srung gdug pa tshar gcod 'khor bcas rnams/ /bdag cag rnams la brtse bas dgongs su gsol/ /mchod gtor zhal zas longs spyod rgya chen 'di/ /'bul lo bzhes shig thugs dam nyer dgongs la/ /'gal rkyen kun srung mthun rkyen ma lus sgrubs/ /thub pa'i bstan pa rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /hūm̐ dpal ldan mgon po dmar po/ /rgyal ba'i bka' srungs dam pa/ /lha srung yongs kyi ded dpon/ /dur khrod kun gyi bdag po/ /rig 'dzin yongs kyi srog shing / /rnal 'byor kun gyi dgra lha/ /bstan pa yongs kyi bya ra ba/ /dug gsum nad kyi sman pa/ /mthu chen drag po/ chos kyi rgyal po/ bse'i khrab can/ bdud btsan rgyal po/ mdung dmar can/ dam nyams kun gyi srog gcod/ mna' zan kun gyi gshed ma/ gnod byed dgra bgegs kyi bdud pho khyed kyi zhal du kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes dang / gtor sngags lan gsum rol mo dang bcas pas gsol kha dang po bstabs/ yang bshams la/ gzhan yang sku'i sprul pa klu btsan/ gsung gi sprul pa bse khrab can/ thugs kyi sprul pa lha'i srung ma rje'i rgyal po/ yon tan gyi sprul pa chos gter srung ma/ phrin las sprul pa mgon po dmag dpon/ de dag gi yang sprul sbrul nag 'bum sde/ spre'u dmar gyi dmag dpung / dge slong bzang po/ dpa' bo stag chas/ byi la gwa pa/ sngags pa nag po/ phyogs skyong zhing skyong / snang srid lha srin sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du kha kha khā hi khā hi/ mchod pa dam pa 'bul zhing gsol lo mchod do/ /zhes dang / ā kā ro'i sngags gang mang rol chen dang bcas pas gsol kha gnyis pa bstabs/ yang bshams la/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' dang bstan pa rin po che la dgongs te khyed rnams kyis dgyes shing mos pa'i stabs kyis bzhes la/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi nad dang gnod pa gdon bgegs thams cad zhi bar mdzod/

tshe dang bsod nams dang dpal 'byor rgyas par spel/ dbang phyug dang nus mthu bskyed/ snyan pa dang grags pa sgrubs/ dregs pa'i 'gro ba pho mo thams cad dbang du bsdus/ gnod byed dgra bgegs thal ba rdul du rlog cig gzhan yang bdag cag rnams kyi rgyags chad kyi ma dang / blo lhag gi pha mdzod cig rgyab kyi slog pa dang / mdun gyi 'khar ba mdzod/ nyin gsum gyi bya ra dang / mtshan gsum gyi mel tshe mdzod/ yo na srongs/ 'gyel na slongs/ chad na 'thud cig ral na tshems shig stor na 'tshol la/ brjed na bskul cig mgo gang gi yar la bstod la/ dkyus gang gi mar la srings shig gzhan yang legs pa brgya dang sprod la/ nyes pa stong dang bsnol cig bsam pa yid bzhin sgrubs la/ re ba rgya mtsho lta bur skongs shig mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol la/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad bzlog cig gnod byed dgra bgegs zlog pa'i ru mtshon gyi rgyal mtshan la brtan par bzhugs te/ dgra dpung choms la bgegs dpung thams cad shigs/ dmag dpung bskyed la ru mtshon 'phyor cig sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs shig dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang chen po bstod cig gzhan yang spo la dar 'phyor la/ khrom du dung bus shig gtam ngan rgyun chod la/ snyan grags 'jig rten du sgrogs shig dam chos mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan nam mkha' la 'phyor la/ mtho ris dang thar pa dang / byang chub sgrub pa'i mgon grogs mdzod cig skyabs dang dpung gnyen dang rten dang brling mdzod cig bdag cag gis ji ltar bsgo ba bzhin bcol pa'i phrin las thams cad myur du sgrubs shig ces 'khor bcas dril ba'i sngags rnams rol chen dang bcas pas gsol kha gsum pa bstabs/ slar yang de 'dra ba tshar gnyis te yongs dril tshar gsum rdzogs pa dang / de dag gi lhag ma lus pa rnams kyang bstabs/ de nas mnga' gsol dpangs bstod rgyas par bya ba ni/ rol dbyangs dang bcas pas/ kho bos brtsams pa'i mnga' gsol ni/༈ kyai hrīḥlas byung ba'i mgon po ni/

/sku mdog padma rā ga'i mdog /'gro la rjes brtser mnga' gsol lo/ /sku la bse khrab dmar po gsol/ /sangs rgyas bstan srung mnga' gsol lo/ /dbu la bse rmog 'od ldan 'gyengs/ /bstan 'dzin dgra lhar mnga' gsol lo/ /phyag g.yas be con klad la bskor/ /dkar phyogs dmag dpon༞ /res 'ga' mdung dmar phyogs bcur 'phyar/ /snyan grags chen por mnga'༞ /phyag g.yon btsan zhags thugs kar 'dzin/ /dam nyams srog gcod mnga'༞ /rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras/ /rgyas pa'i las mdzad mnga'༞ /thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan/ /dug lnga rnam dag mnga'༞ /thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang / /log 'dren gshed mar mnga'༞ /'jigs pa'i me dpung phyogs bcur 'phro/ /bgegs 'joms dpa' bor mnga'༞ /sprul pa'i pho nya las la 'gyed/ /phrin las mnga' bdag mnga'༞ /sgeg cing dpa' la mi sdug pas/ /khyod sku lham mer mnga'༞ /rgod cing drag shul 'jigs rung sgras/ /khyod gsung lhang nger mnga'༞ /snying rje rngam dang zhi ba yis/ /khyod thugs lhan ner mnga'༞ /thabs mkhas thugs rje'i spyod pa can/ /gdul bya'i 'dren par mnga' gsol lo/༈ 'di yan kho bos brtsams/ /hūm̐ gsang ba chen po'i gnas mchog 'dir/ /sha khrag gtor ma ri ltar spungs/ /dza gad bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor 'khyil/ /dri bsur ngad pa sprin ltar gtibs/ /'dod dgu sna tshogs char ltar 'bab/ /ting 'dzin sngags rgyas byin brlabs nas/ /sngar bcol gtang rag 'di 'bul lo/ /da bcol zhu skyems 'di 'dren no/ /bzhes shig rol cig dgongs par mdzod/ /mchod ni dam rdzas gtor mas mchod/ /gsol ni spyan gzigs mchod pas gsol/ /rten ni ru mtshon rtag la brten/ /'bod ni dung chen gling bus 'bod/ /bskang ni mthun pa'i rdzas kyis skongs/ /rbad do sdang byed dgra la rbad/ /bskul lo drag po'i las la bskul/ /chas so dpa' bo dmag la chos/ /bsten no mgon po rgyang ma ring /

/bskul lo mgon po phrag ma dog /g.yab bo mgon po spyan ma rtul/ /'bod do mgon po snyan ma sra/ /gsol lo mgon po thugs ma ring / /gtad do mgon po mthu ma chung / /bskul lo mgon po rtsal ma zhan/ /dam can bstan srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /dam bcas zhal bzhes mdzad pa rnams/ /mthu dang ldan par mnga' gsol lo/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bu bzhin skyongs/ /rtsal dang ldan par mnga' gsol lo/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i dbu 'phang bstod/ /sha la sred par mnga' gsol lo/ /dgra bo'i sha la habs se habs/ /khrag la rngams par mnga' gsol lo/ /dgra bo'i khrag la hubs se hubs/ /srog la dbang bar mnga' gsol lo/ /dgra srog da lta chod la shog /dmag dpon chen por mnga' gsol lo/ /sde brgyad dmag dpung dgra la drongs/ /bstan srung chen por mnga' gsol lo/ /bstan la gnod byed rdul du rlog /chos skyong chen por mnga' gsol lo/ /chos 'khor dar zhing rgyas par mdzod/ /rig 'dzin srung mar mnga' gsol lo/ /gsang sngags mthu dang nus pa bskyed/ /rnal 'byor dgra lhar mnga' gsol lo/ /bcol pa'i las rnams myur du sgrubs/ /zhi ba'i las la mnga' gsol lo/ /nad gdon bar chad zhi bar mdzod/ /rgyas pa'i las la mnga' gsol lo/ /tshe dang bsod rnams rgyas par spel/ /dbang gi las la mnga' gsol lo/ /khams gsum thams cad dbang du bsdus/ /drag po'i las la mnga' gsol lo/ /bstan la gnod cing sdang ba dang / /bla mar brnyas shing sems can 'tshe/ /bsgral ba'i zhing bcur gyur pa yi/ /dgra bo dam nyams las ngan 'di/ /da lta bsgral ba'i dus la babs/ /drag po'i mtshon cha char ltar phobs/ /'jigs pa'i nga ro 'brug ltar sgrogs/ /sha khrag rus pa tshogs su rol/ /don snying sna lnga zhal du gsol/ /yan lag mgo chod rgyan du gyis/ /skyob pa'i lha dang myur du phyes/ /sngon tshe rgyal ba'i bka' ma bcag /bla ma brgyud pa'i dam ma g.yel/ rnal 'byor bdag gi ngag ma bcag

/dus la babs so srung ma'i tshogs/ /khams gsum dgra bo'i srog dbugs la/ /dbang zhing rngams par mnga' gsol lo/༈ 'di bar bdag chen grags blo ba'i mdzad pa'i gur mgon mnga' gsol lo/ /zhes brjod/ de nas gzungs thag rnams bkrol/ khrag chang 'thor ba la brtson pas/ mdun gyi srung ma rnams las pho nya las mkhan stong gsum khyab par 'phros nas/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las thams cad thogs med du sgrubs cing / khyad par dgra bgegs log 'dren thams cad tshar bcad/ sha khrag rus pa sogs rjes med du bzhes/ rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su drangs par bsams la/ hūm̐ gzhan yang khyed la phrin las bcol ba ni/ /bstan pa'i ru tra las ngan sdig can rnams/ /skad cig tsam la thal bar ma rlog na/ /rgyal po chen po khyed la mthu med dam/ /dam can srung ma khyed la rtsal med dam/ /nga la lha med lha la mthu med zer/ /khyed kyang sngon gyi dam las mi 'das sam/ /de bas sngon gyi dam tshig brtser dgongs la/ /bstan pa'i gshed ma 'dul ba'i dus la babs/ /bstan pa'i sgron me lo chen khu dbon gyis/ /khyed kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rten btsugs nas/ /snyigs dus 'gro ba'i mgon du khyed bsngags pas/ /bstan pa phyogs bcur spel ba'i dus la babs/༈ 'di bar gsang phu don grub legs bzang gis so/ /zhes brjod/ de nas mgon po 'khor bcas 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i ru mtshon gzi brjid nus pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa 'phyar ba dang / phyogs su gdengs pa tsam gyis log 'dren thams cad tshar gcod pa'i nus ldan du gyur/ zhes brjod/ de lta bu'i ru mtshon de nyid mdun gyi mgon po 'khor bcas sogs la rten du 'bul ba'i tshig 'di brjod do/ /hūm̐ dpal ldan rtsa brgyud bla ma dang / /yi dam rgyud sde bzhi yi lha/ /dam can chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs/ /lha srin dregs pa'i 'khor bcas dgongs/ /dpal ldan mgon po bse khrab can/

/sku yi sprul pa klu btsan dang / /gsung gi sprul pa btsan rgyal dang / /thugs kyi sprul pa lha srung dang / /yon tan sprul pa gter srung dang / /'phrin las sprul pa dmag dpon dang / /rje yi sprul pa gzi brjid can/ /sde brgyad bshan par bcas pa kun/ /bdag la brtser dgongs rten la bzhugs/ /dur khrod 'bar ba'i ro thang 'dir/ /khrag mtsho 'khyil ba'i rla klong ljongs/ /dam nyams baṃ chen bsgyel ba'i khrir/ /brtan par btsugs pa'i ru mtshon mdung / /dpag bsam ljon pa'i srog shing rtser/ /rno dbal gri lcags mdung so la/ /dug khrag sngags rgod ngar dang ldan/ /lhab lhab 'bar ba'i me 'od can/ /g.yag rgod rog po'i rnga g.yab kyi/ /zhol chen sprin nag lta bur gtibs/ /dar nag ba dan 'phan rtse gsum/ /rlung gis bskyod pas 'phur lding g.yo/ /sku rten ro ras tsa ka li/ /gsung rten srog 'khor gsang ba'i sngags/ /thugs rten gsal ba'i me long dang / /yon tan rten du nyer lnga'i rdzas/ /phrin las rten du dar ras 'phan/ /bse lcags shing byang dam nyams kyi/ /mgo lag 'gron bu'i lan tshar can/ /dril bu g.yer ka sil sil 'khrol/ /phun tshogs rgyu las legs grub cing / /ting 'dzin sngags rgyas byin brlabs pa'i/ /thug chen 'bar ba drag po'i rten/ /rten mchog ru mtshon rgyal mtshan 'di/ /bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha/ /bzhugs pa'i pho brang chen por 'dzugs/ /byin rlabs thugs rje'i sprin sngon las/ /dngos grub char rgyun dus 'dir phob/ /dam can srung ma rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /'du ba'i gnas dang rten du 'dzugs/ /padmo'i mtsho la ngang pa ltar/ /'bral med 'dus nas las kun sgrubs/ /dregs byed dmag dpon ru mtshon mchog /g.yul las rgyal ba'i rten du 'dzugs/ /bstan dang rnal 'byor bdag cag la/ /sdang byed dgra bgegs rdul du rlog /rnal 'byor bdag cag yon mchod kyi/ /srog shing tshe yi rten du 'dzugs/

/mi nor tshe dang legs tshogs kun/ /rab tu rgyas shing brtan par mdzod/ /de ltar ru mtshon rgyal mtshan 'di/ /sngar bcol legs pa'i rten du 'dzugs/ /da bcol zhu ba'i rten du 'dzugs/ /bsam don 'grub pa'i rten du 'dzugs/ /bla ma dkon mchog yi dam lha/ /dam can chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs/ /snang srid dregs byed gzhi bdag rnams/ /ru mtshon 'di la brtan bzhugs nas/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i bstan pa dang / /bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod kyi/ /nyin mtshan bya ra mel tshe dang / /byang chub bar gyi sdong grogs mdzod/ /ces brjod cing mdun gyi bla ma yi dam srung ma rnams dang / snang srid kyi dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud thams cad mtsho la char pa babs pa bzhin du ru mtshon gyi rgyal mtshan de nyid la thim par bsam zhing / mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug khyed rnams ru mtshon gyi rgyal mtshan 'di la brtan par bzhugs nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs/ rnal 'byor pa bdag gi srung ma mdzod/ mi nor dgon gnas longs spyod dang bcas pa'i gnyer mdzod cig bstan pa dang rnal 'byor la sdang ba'i dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad skad cig nyid la tshar chod/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyi srog la dbang mdzod cig ces lan gsum brjod cing / me tog gtor shis brjod kyi tshig skabs su gang babs brjod/ de nas lhag chad kha bskang / brtan bzhugs gshegs gsol/ go bgo bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis rnams bdag bskyed gang yin gyi rjes 'brel dang spyi 'gre bya'o/ /de ltar srung ma rnams la ru mtshon 'dzugs pa'i phan yon ni/ ru mtshon gyi rten de nyid gang du yod par dam can srung ma'i tshogs rnams mkha' la sprin 'du ba'am/ mtsho la ngang pa 'du ba'am/ sha rul la sbrang ma 'du ba ltar gnas de nyid du brtan par bzhugs nas/ yul phyogs dge mtshan ldan pa dang /

sgrub pa po rnams kyi gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'dod don thams cad sgrub par 'gyur bas tshul 'di la brtson par bya'o/ /zhes bse khrab can la bsten pa'i ru mtshon 'dzugs chog khams gsum dpal 'bar 'di yang sa skya pa kun blos nyung 'dus mgyogs par sbyar zhing / rgyas par na 'di'i chos skor yer pa nas thon pa'i gter ma zhig yod 'dra yang kho bos ni go thos tsam las ma mthong bas thugs bzhed can 'dra yod na der gzigs ngos chog khrigs rgyas par mdzad 'tshal ces pa'i yi ge pa ni gzhu lung pa'o// ༈ /swasti/ bse khrab can thug chog gi lag len zin bris byings thams cad nged rang gis brtsams pa'i tse'u dmar ru mtshon zin bris bzhin la/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par/ deng 'dir bstan srung bse khrab can 'khor dang bcas pa'i nang rten ru mtshon 'dzugs pa la zhes dang / rang yi dam du nas gzi brjid dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ hrīḥpadma sogs nyer gcig chos skyong gi sngags brgya rtsa/ 'di'i drag bskul ni/ hūm̐ gzhan yang sogs yin zhing / gzhan tse'u dmar bzhin no// //zhes pa'ang kun blos smras so// //maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ bstan srung bse khrab can la ru mtshon 'dzugs chog PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
